text: D3a-24 opened after re-orienting (head, stage file, diary, validate --open D3 with the known EXPECTATIONS.jsonl error, handback-C5.md's claim, the model's unruled elements). Group: C01, decided order, the heaviest unruled standing element (777 lines: absent 484, restrict 122, instantiate 108, add-condition 39, add-step 23, link 1). C01 is a claim, not a process: 'Most rooms worked on their marks without deciding how they were organized: a decided element of order (a leader, a vote, an oath, a sanction, a division of the work) is coded in 46 of 705 rooms (F-006)'; range from rooms that say they wing it to colour factions holding elections; tiers T4-011 (Decided order: votes 18 rooms, excluding the room's own vandals 13, one member in charge 6, teams 5, handovers 4, oaths 2, elections 2; the other pole, 'We just wing it') and FP-08; dimension D02. No arrow touches it. F-006 (bounded at C3a) holds its count and the bound that decided order gathers in colour factions and hosts that vet requests. G29 is written before any line is read

G29 written in notes-D3.md before any C01 line was read: C01 is shown by either side of the claim in the room: a decided element of order (a vote taken or poll held; a member put in charge, named or elected; an office or role given; an oath; a sanction decided against the room's own members; the work divided among named teams or members by assignment or agreement; the work handed over to named members), or members saying the room works with no plan, leader or rules ('We just wing it', the lower end). Decided or put to the room as a rule; a poll opened counts, an untaken suggestion to vote does not; self-assignment is not a division; any hour, with P13 beside decided elements that set up a lasting group after hour 73. Not shown by calls (P01), design argued without a decision rule (P02), templates or plans (P04, A11), reports (P03), a starter or planner leading by acting (R01, P04), the host's line (P20) or a host's rule over guests alone (P19, candidate), or agreements with other rooms (P08, P17). Not universal; G2 and G3 rule absent lines (observed-absent with no decided element is a specification, C01's majority clause); G9 rules restrict lines; F-006 re-examined if corrections meet twice

G29's readings stated while ruling: (1) a division of the work shows C01 when one member assigns another named member or team a part (rangers 'You connect the bottom of the E'), members agree to a proposed split (hawks), or squads or teams are set (crusaderkings, mexico); a member taking a part and leaving the rest to others (drawhelix, hentai), parts taken unprompted (redpandas), an order of work given to every reader (calgaryflames) and a split offered as an unanswered question (scotland) do not; (2) a room's or host's officers show C01 when they decide by their office (an executive decision, an approval or refusal, a ban, a priority or strategy declared official) or members say the decision is theirs (starlightstage); a request to the mods with no decision (morrowind) and an official plan whose deciders are not shown (denmark) do not; (3) the lower end speaks of how the room is organized (no leader, no management, not organized, no coordination); drawing without a template or permission to place anywhere speaks of the design and does not show it (onepunchman, Thegreatblackhole, swordartonline); (4) members naming a leader show the decided side (apocalypserising, destiny, polska, AvoArmy); (5) the keeper passing the work to named members or to the room as a whole shows a handover (haskell, T3-187's own case); a designer leaving a draft for anyone does not (survivor); (6) a vote or a unanimous answer deciding the room's course counts whatever its subject, alliances included (TheFarLeftSide, poland), the tie itself staying P17's; a post saying a vote is needed with no vote shown does not (GrowTheTree)

The rejects count as decided order what G29 does not (GranColombia's venue demand, bindingofisaac's own part and open call, catalunya's one-member consensus norm, dbz's untaken vote, portugal's chat decision with no procedure), deny what G29 counts (littlewitchacademia's named commanders and diplomats, monstercat's T3-125 exemplar, russia's 'zero coordination'), or do not bear on C01 (funhaus). Further readings of G29: (7) a sanction shows C01 when decided against the room's own members over its canvas work or order (vandalism, attack suggestions, speaking for the room, a chat's security rule); the host's moderation of talk under its standing rules and P20's removals do not, as a vote on a host's own ritual does not (batman, redhotchilipeppers); a sanction whose ground the record does not give is an evidence limit (croatia); (8) a decision reported from the room's chat shows C01 only where its procedure is named (a vote, a majority, consensus); otherwise it is T4-010's backstage decision (portugal, bostonbruins); (1, extended) the room's members split by what they do with a task for each counts as a division (detroitredwings, Rainbow6, berserk, epublica); (4, refined) members naming someone by title (leader, commanders, president, coordinator team) count; thanks for organizing or spearheading credit a member who led by acting (lsu, bostonbruins).
